text:
debrief db-021
1) the actor o-r-g-a-n-i-z-e-d the j-o-i-n-t p-r-i-c-i-n-g s-t-r-a-t-e-g-y for the c-o-n-s-o-r-t-i-u-m and left the a-g-r-e-e-d s-h-e-e-t in the f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n of the t-e-n-d-e-r d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s.
2) the actor c-r-e-a-t-e-d the c-o-v-e-r b-i-d s-u-b-m-i-s-s-i-o-n s from the t-w-o c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s and left the f-i-l-e-s in the s-h-a-r-e-d s-p-a-c-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-n-t-i-c-o-l-l-u-s-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k on the a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l.
3) the actor s-e-t up the r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e for the w-i-n-n-i-n-g r-o-u-n-d-s and left the c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r e-n-t-r-y in the n-o-t-e-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e of the a-r-r-a-n-g-e-m-e-n-t to the a-u-t-h-o-r-i-t-y.
4) the actor a-r-r-a-n-g-e-d the h-i-d-d-e-n c-o-m-p-e-n-s-a-t-i-o-n for the l-o-s-i-n-g b-i-d-d-e-r-s and left the t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-e-i-p-t in the b-a-n-k s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g o-b-l-i-g-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the actor m-o-n-i-t-o-r-e-d the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t p-r-o-c-e-s-s to m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n the a-p-p-e-a-r-a-n-c-e of c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n and left the l-o-g of the c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d m-e-e-t-i-n-g-s while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w of the e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e c-h-a-i-n.
